# GitHub Copilot instructions

Before making changes, read and follow `/AGENTS.md`, then the workflow and security documents it references.

`AGENTS.md` is the repository-wide source of truth. Do not bypass human gates, write scope, security review, testing or human merge requirements.

When plugins/tools are involved, also read `.ai/plugin-governance.md`; external side effects remain subject to task allowlists and human gates.
